reasons.text: Energy charges do not match units x tariff on 100% of bills (worst bill charged 9% of expected)
49% of purchase invoices have suspiciously round tonnages (typical plant: about 2%)
61% of high-value consignments have no e-way bill
Declared capacity of 1,690 t/yr needs about 2.3x the power the plant is connected for
98% of product sales go to buyers incorporated under a year before the invoice
97% of feedstock comes from collectors registered under 6 months before their first invoice

inspection_checklist: Verify the electricity bills directly with the DISCOM (units, tariff, amount); the uploaded copies do not reconcile.
Physically verify a sample of purchase invoices with the sellers (weighbridge slips, e-way bills, vehicle logs).
Obtain the DISCOM consumption statement and meter readings for the flagged months; compare connected machinery (kW) against the claimed tonnage.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
Visit the named collectors: confirm premises, vehicles and storage; check their registration dates and sales to other buyers.
